about.title: About me.
about.subtitle: get to know me
about.desc_1: My passion for computers started in early childhood — some of my first memories are of exploring them, curious about how they worked. In 2019, I took my first step into coding with a Pascal tutorial on YouTube. That simple “Hello, World” sparked something in me. Soon after, I discovered Python and shifted my focus, eventually expanding into multiple languages. Over time, I’ve honed skills in scalability, clean code, maintainability, and best practices — knowledge I’ve gained through real-world experience and by learning from incredible developers along the way.
about.desc_2: Recently, I stepped into two new roles: husband and father — both at 21. These life changes have given me even more drive to grow, not just as a developer, but as a person. Every line of code I write now carries a bit more purpose. I’m passionate about building meaningful things, staying curious, and always improving — in life and in tech.

toolzz.description: Full stack developer on two customer-facing platforms: a chat-based support system and a flow-based chatbot builder. I handle planning, development, bug fixes, code reviews, deployments, and collaborate with designers and clients.

slice.description: At slice, I played a key role in developing customer-facing features for the platform, enabling brands to harness the power of influencer marketing and user-generated content. I collaborated with cross-functional teams to build and optimize scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. My focus was on creating seamless, high-performance experiences that help global brands connect with their audiences and drive impactful marketing results.

nomad.description: At Nomad, I developed and maintained scalable backend services and APIs, focusing on cloud-based solutions to enable seamless international banking experiences for users. I worked in an agile environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver secure and high-performance financial tools.
